import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEmbedding
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleDivisorPresentation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.StructureSheafModuleK.ModulesFunctor
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.ChiCurve

/-!
# The finite ambient section module for the divisor Grassmannian

The pushforward of a line bundle on a proper smooth geometrically integral
curve is free over the ground field, with rank equal to the dimension of its
actual global sections. This supplies the ambient finite-rank hypothesis of
the Grassmannian representability theorem used in campaign D2.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] moduleKSections

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]


set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Global sections of a line bundle on the challenge curve are finite over
the ground field, by its divisor presentation and divisor cohomology. -/
theorem module_finite_sections_of_locallyTrivial_curve
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    Module.Finite k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  obtain ⟨D, ⟨e⟩⟩ := LineBundle.exists_iso_divisorModules k L hL
  let E := (toModuleKSheafOfModulesFunctor C).mapIso e ≪≫
    divisorModulesFieldSheafIso k C D
  let E0 : Sheaf.HModule (C.left.divisorSheaf k D) 0 ≃ₗ[k]
      Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) :=
    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv E.symm 0).trans
      (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology C.left.toTopCat)
        (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : C.left.Opens))
        (toModuleKSheafOfModules C L))
  letI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
  letI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
  exact Module.Finite.equiv E0

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The ambient section module is finite free over the ground field.

The finiteness component is the curve-specific input above; freeness is the
field case of the module structure and is recorded here so Grassmannian
consumers can use the ambient module without reconstructing either witness. -/
theorem module_finite_free_sections_of_locallyTrivial_curve
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    Module.Finite k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) ∧
      Module.Free k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) := by
  letI : Module.Finite k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_locallyTrivial_curve C L hL
  exact ⟨inferInstance, Module.Free.of_divisionRing k _⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The ambient module rank is its finite section dimension. -/
theorem module_rank_sections_eq_finrank_sections_of_locallyTrivial_curve
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    Module.rank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) =
      Module.finrank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) := by
  letI : Module.Finite k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_locallyTrivial_curve C L hL
  exact (Module.finrank_eq_rank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens))).symm

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
